items.feedCategory: GroupBusiness, General meeting, Community Service and Volunteering, Benefit, Fundraising and Philanthropy
items.desc: OttoTHON's General Body is a group of students dedicated to serving the children and families at Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital year-round through event planning, fundraising, and outreach efforts.
